name: deploy_app_multilang
description: Deploy an APK or AAB file with multi-language release notes.

file_path.description: Absolute path to APK or AAB file

release_notes.description:
Dictionary mapping language codes to release notes
          (e.g., {"en-US": "Bug fixes", "es-ES": "Corrección de errores"})

rollout_percentage.description: Rollout percentage (0-100). Default 100 for full rollout.

track.description: Release track - one of: internal, alpha, beta, production
